segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The alarm had fired repeatedly and the pattern in my head felt strong enough on its own, so I treated it as a nuisance.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant estimated the likelihood that the alarm was false from easily recalled prior nuisance alarms without checking current corroborating evidence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I was focused on the panel itself because it was the loudest thing in the room and did not pull up the quieter pressure trend until later.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The prominent audible and visual alarm captured attention while a less salient but relevant pressure trend was overlooked.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The recent four hours looked clean, so I took the stable handover at face value and wrote off the older unresolved drift note as old news.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant overweighted the most recent stable report relative to the older unresolved drift evidence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I ran the standard feed-increase sequence, the same steps I had done about a hundred times, without stopping to reconsider the abnormal precursor.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A highly practiced action sequence was executed automatically without adapting it to the abnormal conditions.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The alarm, temperature climb, and shimmer reminded me of a prior compressor surge, so my instinct was to pull that same response template despite the missing vibration signature.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A superficially similar prior event was used as the diagnostic template despite the absence of a defining feature.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The tube-rupture incident felt like the more likely explanation because it was dramatic and people brought it up in every shift briefing.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The likelihood of a rare failure mode was increased because the memorable incident was socially and mentally available.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I went with the first checklist option that looked workable and did not compare it with the rest because I needed something fast.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Under a closing time window, the participant selected the first adequate option rather than evaluating all alternatives.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The selected action stabilized the immediate trend, but a later review found another checklist step that would have addressed the underlying issue better.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a substantive retrospective outcome assessment without an intentionally embedded hidden bias instance.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: It localizes and matches the recency mechanism, but confirmation bias is not the exact or approved-equivalent hidden label.

candidates.details: The first-option quote is valid and localized, but the candidate itself says time pressure and a legitimate quick response remain plausible; its mechanism only partially overlaps bounded-rationality satisficing.
The exact routine-execution quote and explanation capture the hidden automatic, overlearned action mechanism, but the proposed label is a near-neighbor and the system retained candidate status.

high_only.detection_interpretation: Detection improves as moderate findings and then candidate findings are included; no negative segment receives a finding. High-confidence findings alone detect the two availability segments.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: Detection improves as moderate findings and then candidate findings are included; no negative segment receives a finding. Moderate findings add the recency segment, while overconfidence remains an unsupported positive-segment finding.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: Detection improves as moderate findings and then candidate findings are included; no negative segment receives a finding. No low-confidence findings are present, so this equals high_and_moderate.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: Detection improves as moderate findings and then candidate findings are included; no negative segment receives a finding. Candidate inclusion adds the routine-action and checklist segments; both remain positive segments.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: The RAG explicitly reports that retrieved scientific-paper passages were unavailable and supplies no citation metadata; no retrieved material was provided to independently verify support.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Moderate findings add one mechanism-first instance hit (recency) but also add one unsupported overconfidence false positive; strict TP is unchanged.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: No change because no low-confidence identified findings are present.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: Candidates add one mechanism-first habit hit and two segment detections, while adding two strict/mechanism-first false positives overall.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, 3 of 7 positive segments are detected with no false alarms; candidate inclusion raises this to 5 of 7.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: Two exact availability instances are recovered at every threshold; the recency and habit findings have wrong labels, leaving strict F1 at 0.3636 through all identified findings and 0.3077 with candidates.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first scoring credits the recency finding and, at the candidate tier, the habit finding; F1 rises from 0.4444 at high-only to 0.5455 at high_and_moderate and 0.6154 with candidates.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The habit candidate is a useful mechanism-level near miss that becomes a mechanism-first hit; the anchoring candidate remains unsupported for bounded rationality and adds a false alarm.
main_failure_modes: Wrong construct labels for recency and habit mechanisms.
Unsupported overconfidence identification and partial anchoring candidate.
main_strengths: Exact availability detection at both distinct decision points.
Explicit disclosure that retrieved corpus support was unavailable.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: The run shows strong evidence fidelity and useful mechanism recovery, but incomplete coverage of the seven-instance ontology and a measurable strict-label penalty.
